text_block_list.text: On the way back from an outing with King Halo—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, excuse me.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: "I was able to spend another meaningful day worthy of a first-rate King, but—"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Don't you think it's a bit early to go back to the academy?
It's still so bright outside.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Since we're already out and about,
why don't we walk around a little more?"
choice_data_list: I don't mind, but where shall we go?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Where, you ask? Well, honestly, anywhere...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, right!
You decide where we're going.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: As King's trainer, it should only be natural that you know every first-rate spot there is!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Now then, lead the King, if you please!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Fast food restaurants... Well, I don't dislike them.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
So you thought this place was a first-rate
spot worthy of the King, did you?
choice_data_list: I figured you'd be tired from being out and about.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm, I see.
In that case, maybe I'll order an iced tea."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
In the meantime, you had better
think about our next destination.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: We still have plenty of time. Now, think of a place befitting the King.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Karaoke certainly feels like an obvious way to kill time, but...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Do you honestly believe this karaoke box
is worthy of the King?
choice_data_list: This is practice for singing center stage!
This is practice for when I sing in the center!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I see, I see! O-ho-ho-ho!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: In other words, you're absolutely certain that I'm going to win the race!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Fine, let us practice!
Assuming only that we will sing at the center!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
And another thing—you'd better start thinking
about where we're going after karaoke!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: The place most befitting a King... is the Trainer's room, of all places...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Is that all?
Does this mean you're giving up?
choice_data_list: I thought we could discuss the next race.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Huh, I see...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, not bad!
Let's brainstorm a plan to get the King across the finish line first together!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Before I knew it, it was pitch black outside.
I suppose that just shows how fulfilling it was.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Setting that aside, you did take me around to places
worthy of a King, but...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, every single place was first-rate!
You passed, Trainer!
choice_data_list: I'm glad you were able to enjoy yourself.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Just so you know, as a location,
it was pretty ordinary, okay?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Still, picking a place with King in mind...
I'll at least give you credit for that!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
As expected of my Trainer! Just for today, I grant you
permission to get cocky! Ohohoho!
choice_data_list: Leave where we're headed to me from now on too!
Leave where we're headed to me from now on too!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
As expected of my Trainer! Just for today, I grant you
permission to get cocky! Ohohoho!
choice_data_list: Leave where we're headed to me from now on too!
Leave where we're headed to me from now on too!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"That's a great mindset. Keep that up,
and we can expect you to reach even greater heights."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I'm leaving King's leisure time entirely in your hands.
Continue guiding me to first-rate spots from now on.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: In exchange, King will take you to the glorious stage! Ohohoho!

And in doing so, the bond of trust with
King Halo deepened even further.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Huh!? King is always true to herself!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Honestly... After I went out of my way to praise you,
you go and show that you're still second-rate in that department."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Very well. I will take responsibility
and make you a first-rate Trainer.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Got it? Watch closely and learn what it means
to be first-class! O-ho-ho-ho!
And so, the path to becoming a Trainer worthy of King Halo continued.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it's "only for today,"
so you can't be satisfied with just this.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Keep putting in the effort.
Even King isn't satisfied with just this, after all."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"We shall rise together to become the pinnacle of first-rate!
Ohohohoho!"

Laughing haughtily together with King Halo,
we aimed for even greater heights.
